direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has ended her father's call and taken her leave of Kasun. He notices her changed mood.
direction.people: Kasun stands frame right, facing Anudi off screen to the left. He wears a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, with empty hands at his sides. He is thoughtful but warmly considerate.

flow.text: Kasun keeps his eyes on Anudi. His brows relax and he gives her a small nod.

flow.how: Friendly and considerate, accepting her departure with a slight smile

flow.text: His lips close and he stays where he is, watching Anudi.

direction.camera: Eye-level medium close-up from the road side on a 65mm lens, with a steady frame on a tripod.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
